newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to review Parmalat bid for Ault.
newsitem.headline: Canada to review Parmalat bid for Ault.

text.p: Canada's Competition Bureau said on Tuesday it planned to review Parmalat Finanziaria SpA's C$415 million bid for Canada's Ault Foods Ltd.
"We will be reviewing this proposed transaction," a spokeswoman for the Competition Bureau said in a telephone interview.
She said the bureau would examine the bid to see if it would result in "a substantial lessening of competition" in Canada's dairy products industry.
Parmalat, Italy's largest listed food group, announced its C$34 a share bid on Monday, topping a hostile takeover bid by Saputo Group, a Montreal-based, privately held dairy producer.
Parmalat made the bid with its partner, U.S. bank company Citicorp.

If successful, the acquisition of Ault would be Parmalat's second major acquisition in four months in North America. In March, Parmalat purchased a majority stake in Canada's Beatrice Foods in a C$290 million deal. In that deal, Parmalat also allied itself with Citicorp.
Ault and Beatrice are leading dairy groups in Canada, and a successful bid for Ault would give Parmalat a strong hold on Canada's dairy products industry.
